name: SKYGATE
recent: Skygate Solutions 在2026年第三季度转亏为盈，9个月累计净利达1882万令吉；同时旗下 SkyGate NHJ Technology 在槟城开设新的精密制造设施，并计划投资3000万美元。公司近期也进行了股份回购，董事在闭市期外有小额增持。
notable: 2026年第三季度转亏为盈，9个月累计净利1882万令吉。

risks: 董事 Tay Seng Chew 在闭市期外进行小额股份交易。
主要股东 Dato' Ooi Eng Leong 的持股有变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收3334万令吉，环比增长30.6%，同比增长25.5%；净利2066万令吉，净利率62.0%，较上季度的-10.2%转正，净利同比增长2938.4%。

recent_en: Skygate Solutions returned to profitability in 3Q2026 with 9M26 net profit of RM18.82 million; subsidiary SkyGate NHJ Technology opened a new precision manufacturing facility in Penang and plans a US$30 million investment.
notable_en: Returned to profitability in 3Q2026 with 9M26 net profit of RM18.82 million.
SkyGate NHJ Technology opened a new precision manufacturing facility in Penang and plans a US$30 million investment.
risks_en: Director Tay Seng Chew made small share transactions outside the closed period.
There was a change in the shareholding of substantial shareholder Dato' Ooi Eng Leong.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM33.34 million, up 30.6% QoQ and 25.5% YoY; net income was RM20.66 million with a net margin of 62.0%, turning positive from -10.2% in the previous quarter, and net income grew 2938.4% YoY.
